gcp.storage.standard.class_a.note: Class A operations (writes and lists) on Standard storage in a regional bucket with a flat namespace, the same in every region. The catalog lists one global SKU per 1 operation; the first free tier (the Always Free grant) is ignored.

gcp.storage.standard.class_b.note: Class B operations (reads) on Standard storage in a regional bucket with a flat namespace, the same in every region. The catalog lists one global SKU per 1 operation; the first free tier (the Always Free grant) is ignored.

gcp.storage.standard.storage.note: Standard storage in a regional bucket (GiB-month). The first 5 GB-months a month are free in us-east1, us-west1 and us-central1 only, combined across them for the billing account ("5 GB-months of regional storage (US regions only) per month ... Usage calculations are combined across these regions", https://cloud.google.com/free/docs/free-cloud-features). Of this catalog's regions only us-west1 shares the "US Regional" SKU that lists the free 5 GiB as a $0 first tier; elsewhere both rows carry the one rate. Synced from the Billing Catalog.
